title: Kimberly
details: The only first we had today was Kimberly's first time on a porn set. She's been there, done that and experienced nearly all carnal pleasures. We found her searching for adult gigs online and reached out. It took a few weeks, lots of rescheduling and even more convincing to finally get her to the office, but holy fuck! Her performance was more than worth the effort. Will she continue in the business? One never can tell. Sometimes they decide to disappear after getting the original casting couch treatment. Now I'm off to find another vict.. errr model for next week. I appreciate all of you who are supporting us as this would not be possible without you! See you next week!
